description_en: Registers a custom model for an AI cluster
description_zh: 注册 AI 集群自定义模型
kebab_example: aliyun polardb register-aidb-cluster-custom-model --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --model-name Qwen3-32B --custom-oss-bucket-name my-model-bucket --custom-oss-bucket-path models/qwen3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterAIDBClusterCustomModel

parameters.help_en: The custom model registration key and model directory name
parameters.help_zh: 自定义模型登记键及模型目录名
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: custom_oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The model path in the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: OSS Bucket 内的模型路径
parameters.name: custom_oss_bucket_path

parameters.help_en: The display name in the candidate list and the initial invocation name for clients
parameters.help_zh: 候选清单展示名和初始对客调用名
parameters.name: display_model_name

parameters.help_en: The inference engine. Required when configuring deployment parameters. Valid values: vllm and sglang
parameters.help_zh: 推理引擎。配置部署参数时必填，支持 vllm 或 sglang
parameters.name: inference_engine

parameters.help_en: The GPU instance type used for model deployment. Required when configuring deployment parameters
parameters.help_zh: 模型部署使用的 GPU 实例规格。配置部署参数时必填
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The model startup parameters. Parameter keys must start with --
parameters.help_zh: 模型启动参数。参数键需以 -- 开头
parameters.name: model_params

parameters.help_en: The direct startup command for the model container
parameters.help_zh: 模型容器直接启动命令
parameters.name: direct_command

parameters.help_en: The container startup environment variables. Variable names cannot be empty or contain whitespace. Variable values can be empty strings
parameters.help_zh: 容器启动环境变量。变量名不能为空或包含空白，变量值可为空字符串
parameters.name: container_env

parameters.help_en: The full reference of the customer-owned inference image, in the format of registry/repository:tag
parameters.help_zh: 客户自有推理镜像的完整引用，格式为 registry/repository:tag
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The username for the customer image repository. Required when ImageName is specified
parameters.help_zh: 客户镜像仓库用户名。传入 ImageName 时必填
parameters.name: registry_username

parameters.help_en: The password or temporary token for the customer image repository. Required when ImageName is specified
parameters.help_zh: 客户镜像仓库密码或临时令牌。传入 ImageName 时必填
parameters.name: registry_password

Created.description_en: Indicates whether a new registration is created. A value of false indicates that an existing registration is updated
Created.description_zh: 是否新建；false 表示更新已有登记
Created.title_en: 是否新建；false 表示更新已有登记。
Created.title_zh: 是否新建；false 表示更新已有登记。

DisplayModelName.description_en: The display name and the initial invocation name for clients
DisplayModelName.description_zh: 展示名和初始对客调用名
DisplayModelName.title_en: 展示名和初始对客调用名。
DisplayModelName.title_zh: 展示名和初始对客调用名。

ImageImportStatus.description_en: The image import status. The initial value is Importing after an image is registered
ImageImportStatus.description_zh: 镜像导入状态。带镜像登记后初始值为 Importing
ImageImportStatus.title_en: 镜像导入状态。带镜像登记后初始值为 Importing。
ImageImportStatus.title_zh: 镜像导入状态。带镜像登记后初始值为 Importing。

OssPath.title_en: 归一化后的 OSS 路径。
OssPath.title_zh: 归一化后的 OSS 路径。
